objective: Replace the structured-text-only Pie, Radar, QuadrantChart, and Venn outputs with genuine deterministic terminal chart geometry. Implement mermansi-native bounded Canvas geometry without modifying or forking merman-core, merman-ascii, Selkie, or any parser. Pie must draw a closed circular/radial chart with visible sector boundaries or proportional sector fill derived from every finite nonnegative section value, plus a compact legend preserving every label, value, percentage, title, and showData semantics; a bar/table alone is not acceptable. Radar must draw a shared center, radial axis spokes, graticule rings or polygons, and connected plotted curve vertices normalized from configured min/max while preserving every axis label, curve label/value, ticks, graticule choice, showLegend, and title. QuadrantChart must draw a closed Cartesian plotting area with midpoint cross-axes, all four quadrant labels in their actual regions, endpoint axis labels, and every point placed from its normalized x/y coordinates with deterministic collision-safe markers/callouts; preserve class and style metadata without pretending terminal color is geometry. Venn must draw closed overlapping set outlines for the semantic singleton sets, place intersection/subset and text labels in or connect them to their associated regions, preserve sizes, labels, styles, and arbitrary parsed subsets, and remain genuine geometry rather than a Subsets/Text Nodes list. For every family preserve Complete-mode canonical models, Concise-mode chart geometry with no structured-text fallback, ASCII and Unicode geometry, Chinese/CJK display widths, ANSI-independent geometry, determinism, control sanitization, and typed width/height/cell/byte/entity limits before allocations. Add strong tests for shape closure, proportional/coordinate placement, axis/spoke/curve connectivity, overlap identity, collision handling, empty/zero/invalid constructed models, bilingual fixtures, narrow widths, ASCII, determinism, and bounds. Update AGENTS.md, README.md, and docs/SUPPORT_MATRIX.md honestly. Apply KISS, YAGNI, DRY, and SOLID: reuse only minimal chart primitives that are genuinely shared.

steps.description: Validate ticks without clamping, choose compact dimensions from tick/axis needs, return typed limits when configured rings cannot fit, and bound the sum of all curve entries before Canvas/vector allocation.

Establish explicit layers: sparse graticule, force-drawn light spokes, force-drawn distinguishable curve strokes, then markers/labels; crop the canvas and append truthful Scale/Axes metadata plus optional curve legend.
Avoid temporary unbounded data-range collections, reject invalid min/max ranges, preserve invalid raw entries in legends, and keep showLegend/graticule/title/CJK/ASCII semantics.
Add exact compact/ticks/connectivity/crossing test with coordinate-component inspection and a constructed total-entry bound test; visually inspect fixtures and run full verification.

implementation.summary: Reworked Radar into explicit sparse-grid, force-spoke, force-curve, marker, and label layers; derived compact dimensions from configured ticks; removed silent tick clamping; enforced tick and total-entry limits before geometry/vector allocation; replaced the temporary data-range Vec with a fold; validated min/max; cropped the canvas; and added Scale/Axes metadata plus optional sanitized legends.

verification.summary: The exact six-tick compactness, four-axis endpoint, curve-component connectivity, crossing precedence, showLegend, ASCII, and tick-limit test passed. The 4097-entry pre-allocation bound test passed. fmt, clippy -D warnings, and all-target/all-feature tests passed; 209 tests passed with zero failures. Manual English/Chinese fixtures measured about 19 rows instead of about 46.

summary: Current Codex diff and rendered-output review found no actionable defects for Issue #0006. Configured ticks are honored through 18 and rejected explicitly beyond capacity, total entries are counted safely before allocation, curves overwrite grid/spokes at crossings and remain coordinate-connected, every axis is visible in geometry and metadata, showLegend is respected, and Unicode/ASCII/CJK output is compact, bounded, deterministic, and sanitized. Shared force-line/crop primitives keep layering DRY without speculative abstraction.

resolutions.description: Acceptance met by compact layered geometry, explicit tick/entry limits, force-drawn connected curves, preserved options/labels, coordinate-aware tests, visual inspection, and clean full verification.
